question: industrial-roller-doors
unit: ea (one complete motorised insulated roller door, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)

band.unit: ea (one complete motorised insulated roller door, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)
band.basis: Sum of the six components per door: door unit $7,600-$9,300 + motor $1,100-$1,600 + controls/safety $500-$1,200 + final electrical connection $150-$420 + scissor lift (amortised) $50-$160 + delivery/offload (amortised) $60-$150 = $9,460-$12,830 per door. Total for the nominal 4 identical doors = $37,840-$51,320, which is where the amortised lift and delivery sit. GST exclusive, NZD, Auckland, QV rates already GST exclusive and web rates converted from GST-inclusive where used. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design and consent, the structural opening, the 3-phase supply/submain/isolator/containment, vision panels/wicket doors/fire rating/wind upgrade, remote controls beyond the fixed station, loop detectors, PLC/card interface, painting and patching, temporary weather closure, and service/warranty beyond 12 months, all per scope. Confidence is LOW because the largest component (the insulated aluminium motorised door unit, ~65% of the door) is a QV proxy for a steel chain-operated shutter with a 65-90% uplift, and no NZ publisher prints a rate for this exact specification.

band.unit: $/ea (one complete motorised insulated roller shutter door, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)
band.basis: Auckland, NZD, GST EXCLUSIVE, one door 4.0m W x 4.5m H nominal 18.0 m2, 4 identical doors installed in one visit, no preliminaries, margin, design or consent (all excluded by the scenario). Per-door band = sum of components: low 7400+1100+500+270+0+85+125 = 9480; high 9300+2300+1200+500+0+225+300 = 13825; midpoint 11,653/ea. TOTAL FOR THE 4-DOOR NOMINAL QUANTITY: low 37,920; high 55,300; midpoint 46,600 - the two amortised items (scissor lift and delivery) are divided by 4 inside each per-door figure. Allowances (controls/safety 500-1200 and delivery 125-300) carry 625-1500 of each per-door figure, about 7-11% of the band - well under a third, so the band is carried by cited QV rows and proxies, not by judgement. Whole-door rate is a QV proxy for a different curtain material (zincalume steel for insulated aluminium) with the adjustment stated; the corroborating published pages are retailer price guides, not project quotes, so treat the band as a cost-plan check, not a certified price.

band.unit: ea (one complete motorised 4.0m x 4.5m insulated roller shutter, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)
band.basis: Sum of the ten components above, per door: low $6,502 + $1,620 + $1,300 + $600 + $1,100 + $500 + $800 + $80 + $100 + $300 = $12,902; high $7,121 + $2,520 + $2,136 + $1,200 + $1,440 + $1,300 + $1,800 + $200 + $250 + $600 = $18,567. Mid-point approx $15,700/ea. Nominal quantity 4 identical doors, one visit: total $51,608 (low) to $74,268 (high), mid approx $62,900. GST exclusive, excludes preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees. QV rows used are unreviewed and UK/NZ vendor guides are not project quotes: treat this as a cost-plan band, not a price. Allowances (hood, controls/safety, delivery) are ~13% of the mid total. Indications from the fetched guides that bracket this band: installed medium commercial doors $4,000-$7,500 and large 5-8m installed $7,000-$12,000, before an insulated aluminium curtain, full safety package and 3-phase drive are added.
